approved_findings.location: line 14, contrasted with lines 24 and 45 plus 01-build-button-chain/goal.md line 11
approved_findings.summary: The top-level desired outcome contradicts the plan's own button count, completion trigger, and border-color contract.
approved_findings.observed_contradiction: The desired outcome requires two initial buttons, completion when pressing the third generated button, and a visible black border, while the same plan later requires the initial button, fourth-generated-button completion, and a visible white border.
approved_findings.impact: A future executor could implement the wrong initial state, stop the chain one generated button early, or render the wrong border color while still appearing to follow the top-level outcome section.
approved_findings.evidence: plan-description.md line 14 says the implementation must show two initial buttons, finish on the third generated button, and use a black border. plan-description.md line 24 scopes the initial button, fourth-generated-button completion, and visible white border. plan-description.md line 45 repeats completion only on the fourth generated button, and 01-build-button-chain/goal.md line 11 requires one starting button with the final exact text inside a visible white border.
approved_findings.required_correction: Rewrite the desired outcome so it matches the validated contract: one initial button, each current-last-button click appends exactly one button, pressing the fourth generated button clears the document, and the final lowercase finished text is inside a visible white border.

approved_findings.location: lines 9-21, with validator confirmation in validation.md lines 5-8 and plan-description.md lines 61-64
approved_findings.summary: The retained adversarial-review gate is still unresolved and the plan's own validator fails on that gate.
approved_findings.observed_contradiction: The adversarial review lists open or in-progress findings and a pending verdict, while the plan retains an adversarial-review section that also records pending status; validation.md confirms this is not an approved plan state.
approved_findings.impact: The plan cannot be approved or adopted because its terminal review evidence still records unresolved findings and a failed approval gate.
approved_findings.evidence: adversarial-review.md lines 9-15 list AR-01 as open and AR-02 as in progress. adversarial-review.md lines 17-21 record Status: pending because final Reviewer B returned overall_plan_approval=false. validation.md lines 5-8 reports failures for unapproved adversarial review, non-mirrored approved status, and unresolved review findings. plan-description.md lines 61-64 also leaves adversarial-review status pending.
approved_findings.required_correction: Resolve or remove stale review findings through a fresh independent review, update adversarial-review.md to an approved verdict only if warranted, synchronize plan-description.md with that approved status, and rerun validation to a passing result before adoption.
